summary: AI engineer with four years building and shipping production LLM and computer-vision-adjacent systems end to end. I design tool-calling agents, RAG and retrieval over messy real-world data, plus prompt engineering, output evaluation and guardrails — and I own the full loop from prototype to production. Strong Python, LangChain/LangGraph, APIs and PostgreSQL; comfortable working directly with customers to deploy AI into operational workflows.

bullets: Built an LLM-powered decision-support agent that retrieves domain data and generates recommendations and diagnostic guidance, deployed to real users.
Designed retrieval, prompt, and output-guardrail layers for a production system, evaluating model output for correctness and reliability.
Owned the full AI feature lifecycle: architecture, retrieval and prompt design, output validation, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Built the retrieval and data layer (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis); caching and optimized queries improved data-access performance by **30%** for high-frequency inference calls.
Built an AI-driven platform with LangChain and RAG pipelines, normalizing third-party data and retrieving context to generate personalized user outputs.
Developed an AI Virtual Trainer agent with agentic reasoning and personalization, increasing user engagement by **40%**; owned design, development, and deployment.
Built a full-stack AI system (Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL) applying LLM extraction to automate workflows.
Engineered a GPT-Canvas-style streaming LLM renderer achieving **98%** rendering accuracy.
Built Refill Arena from zero to **$1M+ revenue**, owning backend infrastructure, data models, and scalable APIs across **3,200+ brands** and **190+ countries**.
Delivered features end to end with remote stakeholders; improved backend performance by **25%** through query optimization and caching.
